name: spinner
description: Warframe fork of hoobnn's spinner mod: a mascot beside the spinner, a pixel scene above the prompt, a finale and a companion pet, in six Warframe themes (fissure, titania, khora, dante, gyre, qorvex) plus upstream's fifteen

visible.title: Show the animations
visible.description: The animations at all: the mascot, the band and the companion (/spinner off and /spinner on change this too)

footerButton.title: Footer button
footerButton.description: A Spinner button in the prompt footer that turns the animations off and on, as /spinner off and /spinner on do

theme.title: Theme
theme.description: The animations' look. Warframe: fissure (Excalibur cracking a relic), titania, khora, dante, gyre, qorvex. Upstream: clawd, thunder, chomp, sparky, bluecat, nyan, cat, bunny, sakura, mecha, neon, dino, ocean, matrix, audio (macOS 14.2+). random draws a Warframe theme each session. /spinner <theme> switches it live

stage.title: Animation band
stage.description: An animated scene above the prompt (two to four rows, by theme) while the model works (/spinner stage off|on overrides it)

celebrate.title: Finale
celebrate.description: A short finale in the band when a turn ends: confetti and the time it took, or a sad face when interrupted

companion.title: Companion
companion.description: A pet in a row above the prompt: it shows what the model is doing (the tool running, a permission waiting), stays between turns, levels up as turns finish, and a click or /spinner pet pats it (/spinner companion off|on overrides it)

reducedMotion.title: Reduced motion
reducedMotion.description: Draw the mascot, the band's scene and the pet as still pictures: they still change with what the model does, without moving

language.title: Language
language.description: Language of /spinner's replies and the finale's label; auto follows Claude Code's language setting, then the system locale
